metaforas.Recruta: Raw iron just entered the fire. Every blade starts as shapeless matter.
metaforas.Aprendiz: The metal already takes shape. The first hammer strikes set the direction.
metaforas.Guerreiro: Metal only becomes a blade after weeks in the fire. You withstood the hottest part.
metaforas.Guardião: The blade gained its edge. Now it protects the one who forged it.
metaforas.Espartano: Tempered in discipline, the blade no longer chips under pressure.
metaforas.Monge: The steel learned silence. Strength that no longer needs to prove itself.
metaforas.Mestre: You stopped being forged to start forging.
metaforas.Lenda: Few metals reach this point of temper. Yours has.
metaforas.Imortal: Steel that time doesn't rust. The forge is now part of who you are.
